summary: The article provides a generally reliable overview of ELSS funds and their tax benefits, though some specific tax rates and exemption limits for LTCG have been updated recently.

claims.claim: ELSS funds predominantly invest in the equity markets. As per SEBI regulations, ELSS funds invest at least 80% of their assets in equity and equity-related instruments.
claims.note: SEBI Investor website states that an ELSS is a diversified equity mutual fund where at least 80% of the corpus is invested in equity and equity-related instruments.

claims.claim: You can claim a deduction of up to ₹1.5 lakhs in a financial year by investing in ELSS funds, alongside other eligible instruments like PPF, life insurance premiums, home loan principal repayment, and EPF contributions.
claims.note: Section 80C of the Income Tax Act allows a maximum deduction of ₹1.5 lakh per year for investments in specified financial instruments, including ELSS.

claims.claim: This deduction is available only under the old tax regime.
claims.note: Section 80C deduction is available only under the old tax regime, not the new regime.

claims.claim: As per recent announcements, if your capital gains from equity-oriented mutual funds (including ELSS) exceed ₹1.25 lakh in a financial year, the gains above this threshold are taxed at 12.5% without indexation. This rate applies to specified listed securities transferred on or after July 23, 2024.
claims.note: Long-term capital gains (LTCG) on equity-oriented mutual funds exceeding ₹1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5% without indexation, effective July 23, 2024.

claims.claim: ELSS funds have a mandatory lock-in period of three years.
claims.note: ELSS funds have a mandatory lock-in period of three years.

claims.claim: This lock-in is the shortest among all tax-saving instruments available under Section 80C.
claims.note: The ELSS lock-in period of 3 years is the shortest among all tax-saving instruments under Section 80C.

claims.claim: Even if you opt for the new tax regime where Section 80C benefits are not available, the three-year lock-in remains mandatory for ELSS funds.
claims.note: Taxpayers opting for the new tax regime cannot claim the Section 80C deduction, but the ELSS lock-in period remains mandatory.

article_title: ELSS: Understanding Equity Linked Saving Scheme Funds & Tax Benefits
